Synthetic ArcGIS query responses in the shape of the SLO County SurfSafeSLO public
view (`SurfSafeSLO_Public_View/FeatureServer/0`, as `fish`'s collector reads it).
Station codes, names, ids and coordinates are invented; only the field names follow
the county view. `last_edited_date` is present so the tests can show it is never
used as a sample date.
